analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 31.3으로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램 -293.4928로 악화 지속. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.35로 증가했으나 추세 전환 신호 미약. 52주 저가 대비 19.6% 위치. ATR 4,287원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(5,573원) 설정 시 진입가 73,450원, 손절 67,877원, 목표 84,023원(손익비 1.78). 그러나 추세 전환 근거 부족으로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI at 31.3, entering oversold territory, and MACD histogram at -293.4928, continuing to worsen. Volume ratio to 5-day average increased to 1.35, but trend reversal signals are weak. Positioned at 19.6% from the 52-week low. With a stop loss set at 1.3x ATR (4,287 KRW), which is 5,573 KRW, an entry at 73,450 KRW would imply a stop at 67,877 KRW and a target at 84,023 KRW (risk/reward 1.78). However, lacking strong trend reversal evidence, a wait-and-see stance is maintained.

analysis.narrativeEn:

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.35x): increased momentum, higher reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): weak trend reversal signals, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
